description: Schedule the same post in multiple languages, linking all variants into one translation group.

mediaUrl.description: Optional shared public HTTPS media URL.

mediaUrls.description: Optional shared public HTTPS media URLs.

scheduledAt.description: Future ISO 8601 publish time for every language version.

team_id.description: Team ID to operate in team scope. Get available teams with list_teams. If omitted, uses personal scope.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone stored with the scheduled posts.

title.description: Optional shared title for supported platforms.

versions.description: Language-specific post variants. Maximum 11 versions per request.

lang.description: Language code such as en, es, fr, or de.

targetAccounts.description: Connected account IDs for this language version.

text.description: Localized post text for this version.

name: schedule_multilang_content
title: Schedule Multilang Content
